title: Tapped Delay Resettable Synchronous
text: Delay scalar signal multiple sample periods and output all delayed versions when external Reset signal is false, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Sample time} sets Time between samples; {Initial condition} sets the initial output, {Number of delays} sets the number of discrete-time operators, {Order output vector starting with} sets the order of output and {Include current input in output vector}. Values come from the instance.
